Hi friend,

1. 參考 rugarch package:

http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/rugarch/vignettes/Introduction_to_the_rugarch_package.pdf (46頁)

2. 該 pdf 第4頁 2.1 Univariate ARFIMAX Models
有提及 general ARFIMAX model 可應用於ARCH-in-mean effects (Engle
et~al. 1987).

3. 另說明文件 (107頁), 建議先參考其 example
http://cran.cs.pu.edu.tw/web/packages/rugarch/rugarch.pdf

請參考上述說明.
